{"blocking_evidence":null,"headline":"same referent endpoint","reader_payoff":"The reader sees that the one who governs punishment and mercy is also the destination toward whom the addressees are turned.","reason":"The pronoun suffix is resolved by attachment evidence to the divine agent encoded in the preceding verbs.","representative_source_ids":["QG-570b35b1","MS-dd791ec6","QY-536186aa"],"status":"used"}
Making proceeds through prior measure and first construction, then proves its power by turning the made thing back into renewed existence.

1. **Two allocated conditions terminate in a forced reversal.** Lexical evidence: `يُعَذِّبُ`, root `ع ذ ب`, `B005` (torment and punishment); `يَرْحَمُ`, root `ر ح م`, `B001` (mercy and tenderness); and `تُقْلَبُون`, root `ق ل ب`, `B004` (turning and reversing) with `B005` (return and destination). Structural cue: punishment and mercy are grammatically balanced, then both subjects are gathered into the one passive reversal; `29:22-25` show failed escape, despair, rescue, and alliances reversing into disavowal. Assigned role: punishment and mercy are distinct assigned conditions; reversal removes the subjects from their present orientation. Abductive move: the packet does not specify the intermediate causal route, so I infer only that divine allocation controls the direction of the final turn. Reading change: `تقلبون` reads as being decisively reoriented and returned, not voluntary turning.

{"gloss_range":"repeated headless relative whoever, filling the mercy-recipient slot under the same will frame","prose":"The second {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) mirrors the first open object slot. Mercy is not grammatically given a narrower doorway than punishment: the same relative form leaves its recipients unnamed until {{ar:يَشَاءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) completes the clause. Because the two whoever-slots are formally identical, the wording itself does not force the two sets to be mutually exclusive.","root_display":"— (no root)","root_gloss_range":null,"surface_display":"{{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}})"}

- **Later activation (`29:55`, `29:58`):** Punishment covering from above and below is later countered by prepared upper chambers with rivers beneath. These opposed vertical habitats give `تُقْلَبُون` a fuller force: reversal reallocates the same spatial axes into radically different experienced conditions.
